background.comment: ADR-0051 — corrected from {color.semantic.success}, was violating Brand Guide v1.0 §11.3 ("do not use Brand Green as Success" applied in reverse: Primary must not ride on the Success token)

background-hover.comment: ADR-0051 — direct primitive step per Brand Guide v1.0 §8.2, not routed through semantic.success-hover

text.comment: ADR-0071 D1 — was {color.text.inverse}, a role that flips to black in the dark theme while the three grounds above never change: 4.37 / 3.15 / 2.23 there. on-brand is the role for text on a filled brand ground and does not flip: 4.81 / 6.67 / 9.40 in every theme

background.comment: ADR-0071 D2 — was {color.semantic.error}, which follows the theme (#E53E3E in dark) while hover and pressed below do not. The three grounds are now fixed in every theme, as the primary button's are. The `Destructive` variant per Brand Guide §8.1; not Brand Red (ADR-0051, §11.3)

text.comment: ADR-0071 D2 — was {color.text.inverse}: black on the fixed hover and pressed grounds in dark, 3.20 / 2.58. White measures 4.98 / 6.57 / 8.15 in every theme

background.comment: ADR-0051 — new, shared by all button variants per Brand Guide v1.0 §8.2

text.comment: ADR-0051 — color alone is not the disabled signal; consuming components MUST also apply reduced opacity, cursor: not-allowed, and aria-disabled per §8.2

ring.comment: ADR-0051 — new, independent of button color per Brand Guide v1.0 §9
